scope: ReplayRun class-declared identity + tape-pair grammar, keyed on the RESOLVED class in the broker route (authoritative) and the owned kind name at parse (early refusal). The class exists and is registered this slice.
non_goals: pair on every P4 replay admission

registration.module: NEW dskit/pipeline/replay.py (a kinds-style module), imported by dskit/pipeline/__init__.py beside the other kind modules; no node.py<->document.py cycle (replay.py imports node.py, never the reverse).
registration.call: register_node_kind(REPLAY_RUN_KIND, ReplayRun, owned=True) executes at package import, so DEFAULT_NODE_KINDS holds the owned 'replay' kind in every run.
registration.kind_literal: REPLAY_RUN_KIND = "replay" single owner (replay.py re-exports it; document.py imports it for the parse rule).

identity.class: ReplayRun(Node) with role = "replay" (new ROLES member in document.py) and the two-input NodeSpec contract (tape_manifest, tape_data).
identity.run: fixes M2: ReplayRun.run() RAISES a clear refusal ('replay execution requires the F3 composed-tape broker, follow-on'); it does NOT mint any opaque capability. The class is registered (concrete role/outputs) so node_class_errors passes; its run() is honest refusal, not fabricated verification.
identity.outputs: ReplayRun.outputs is a declared non-empty tuple (satisfies node_class_errors); its exact output name is frozen in RED.

enforcement.authoritative: fixes M1/M3: trust.py broker route, when it processes an execution document's node map, resolves each node's uses via resolve_uses and, if issubclass(resolved.cls, ReplayRun), enforces inputs exactly {tape_manifest, tape_data} (each a complete P5 descriptor). This covers BOTH spellings (kind name and class ref) by resolved class, before private planning/root creation.
enforcement.early_parse: document.py from_obj, keyed on uses == REPLAY_RUN_KIND (the owned registry key): the node must be in an execution_backtest document AND declare exactly the pair; a non-execution document referencing the owned kind refuses. This is an early convenience refusal; the broker route is authoritative.
enforcement.resolves: C1 (registration path), M1 (class-ref spelling caught by broker resolved-class check), M3 (broker raw-dict reader enforces on the resolved class), M2 (run() honest refusal).

positive_grammar: inputs == {tape_manifest: {$captured_artifact: D1}, tape_data: {$captured_artifact: D2}}; D1, D2 each an exact P5 six-field descriptor.

cases: a third input key beside the pair
a renamed port carrying a descriptor
a descriptor as a list/map input value
a non-ReplayRun node declaring the two ports not swept
class-ref spelling caught by broker resolved-class check

compatibility.p4_replay: pair rule fires only on ReplayRun identity; accepted P4 final-replay fixtures remain green.
compatibility.p5_p6: descriptor shape and generic equality unchanged.
compatibility.purity: pipeline never imports production; ReplayRun is pipeline-owned.

forbidden_effects: planning/stage compilation completes before grammar refusal
node/adapter import or construction before refusal
uses-string resemblance or document role key as identity authority

tests.new: tests/pipeline/test_replay_tape_descriptors.py: positive pair; missing/extra/aliased/nested/wrong_name/identity (broker resolved-class + parse owned-kind); class-ref spelling caught; ReplayRun.run() refusal; non-execution replay-kind refusal; P4 compatibility; a one-name pin test (ReplayRun.role == 'replay' == REPLAY_RUN_KIND == owned kind).
